name: Crime and Punishment
source:
Dostoevsky’s complete, unabridged Russian text staged as a visual novel, with illustrated scenes and optional choices that preserve the original. 

The whole novel. Nothing abridged.

Enter the heat, debt and fever of Dostoevsky’s Saint Petersburg. This interactive edition presents the complete russian text of Crime and Punishment, all six parts and both chapters of the epilogue with no prose summarized, rewritten or removed.

Illustrated locations, character staging and pivotal moments give the book rhythm and a sense of place without replacing the author’s words.

Optional decisions open brief alternative passages, clearly separated from Dostoevsky’s prose, and always return to the canonical text.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5170980/Crime_and_Punishment
translation:
将陀思妥耶夫斯基未作任何删节的俄文原著完整搬上视觉小说舞台，配以精美插画场景与不破坏原著风貌的可选分支。

全本呈现，一字未删。

步入陀思妥耶夫斯基笔下燥热、债台高筑而又狂热迷乱的圣彼得堡吧。本互动版本完整收录了《罪与罚》全部六部及尾声两章的俄文原文，未对任何段落作概括、改写或删减。

精心绘制的场景插画、人物立绘调度与关键情节演出，在不取代作家原句的前提下赋予整部巨著鲜活的节奏感与临场气息。

可选分支会开启简短的平行插曲，与陀思妥耶夫斯基的原著正文清晰区分，并在随后始终回归正典主线。
